reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is monitoring session stop conditions and delivering Feishu/Lark notifications, with optional workspace routing and process-death watchdog monitoring.

summaries.zh: 监控 DeepSeek Harness 会话的停顿、完成、错误和进程状态，并通过 lark-cli 将通知发送到飞书或 Lark。
summaries.en: Monitors DeepSeek Harness session pauses, completions, errors, and process status, then sends notifications to Feishu or Lark through lark-cli.

capabilities: Observes DeepSeek Harness session and agent lifecycle events
Can monitor process heartbeats with an external watchdog script
Provides setup, status, test, and routing commands
